youtube.title: Plane mein kaan kyun bund ho jaate hain? ✈️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Plane mein baithte hi kaan achanak bund ho jaate hain, aur phir ek "pop" ke saath khul jaate hain. Iske peeche ek chhoti si nali hai, jiske baare mein zyadatar logon ne kabhi suna hi nahi.

Kaan ke parde ke peeche hawa ki ek chhoti si jagah hoti hai. Plane upar jaata hai to cabin ka pressure kam hota hai, aur parda bahar ki taraf phool jaata hai. Nigalne, jamhai lene ya chabane se wo nali khulti hai aur pressure barabar ho jaata hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
